caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical mug with a rounded base and a flared rim, rendered in grayscale pencil. The mug features two engraved decorative bands: one near the top and one above the lower base, both with intricate patterns. The handle, attached at the top and bottom, arches outward and is adorned with a twisted rope or braid-like design along its length. The mug casts a soft shadow to its lower right. The drawing is centrally placed within a square border. In the upper right and lower left corners of the border, there are two smaller inset sketches showing detailed cross-sections and patterns from the mug: the upper right inset displays the horizontal designs of the banding, and the lower left inset shows a vertical cross-section of the handle’s rope detail. The entire image is executed in shades of gray and black pencil on off-white or yellowed paper, with a handwritten signature near the bottom right of the main drawing.
title: Silver Mug
